searchStringsArray.title: Search terms
searchStringsArray.description: What to search for, e.g. 'dentist'. One term per line.

maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search term
maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.description: How many businesses to collect for each search term. Start small while testing.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the Google Maps results.

maxPagesPerWebsite.title: Max pages to scan per website
maxPagesPerWebsite.description: How many pages of each business website to scan for contact details. Higher finds more but takes longer.

skipPlacesWithoutWebsite.title: Skip businesses with no website
skipPlacesWithoutWebsite.description: Businesses with no website can never have an email, so they are usually not worth keeping.

onlyPlacesWithEmail.title: Only keep results that have an email
onlyPlacesWithEmail.description: Turn on for a clean lead list. Turn off to keep every business.
